definitions.gloss: enrollment fee; entrance fee paid upon admission to a school
definitions.explanation: A one-time fee paid when entering a school, university, or other educational institution in Japan. This is separate from tuition and is typically non-refundable.

examples.japanese: {入学金|にゅうがくきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧。
{入学金|にゅうがくきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十万円|さんじゅうまんえん}だった。

⟦{私立|しりつ}→私立：00370_shiritsu⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入学金|にゅうがくきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The enrollment fee for private universities is often higher than for national universities.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧ (enrollment/admission) and {金|きん} (money/fee). In the Japanese education system, {入学金|にゅうがくきん} is a standard one-time payment required upon acceptance to a school, separate from ⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧ (tuition). It is typically non-refundable, even if the student decides not to attend.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入学金|にゅうがくきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the entrance fee
- {入学金|にゅうがくきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧: to pay/submit the entrance fee (formal)
- {入学金|にゅうがくきん}⟦{免除|めんじょ}→免除：05764_menjo⟧: exemption from the entrance fee
- {入学金|にゅうがくきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返還|へんかん}→返還：14357_henkan⟧: refund of the entrance fee

RELATED WORDS:
